# remix of

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:remixOf`](gmeow-remixOf.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/remixOf>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/creative-works`](../../slices/creative-works.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A flat shortcut asserting that a creative work is a remix derived from another creative work. The reified form is a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) with [`gmeow:derivationType`](gmeow-derivationType.md) [`gmeow:derivationTypeRemix`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeRemix.md).

Use [`gmeow:remixOf`](gmeow-remixOf.md) from [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) to [`gmeow:CreativeWork`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeWork.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the flat 80% case of asserting one work is a remix of another, when no segment, period, or provenance needs recording.

### Avoid when

- Avoid when the derivation's segments, combined types, or provenance must be first-class — promote to a [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) with [`gmeow:derivationTypeRemix`](../individuals/gmeow-derivationTypeRemix.md).

### How to use

- Assert from the remix to the source recording; it [`pairsWith`](gmeow-pairsWith.md) [`gmeow:CreativeDerivation`](../classes/gmeow-CreativeDerivation.md) — promote when metadata is required.

- ex:clubMix [`gmeow:remixOf`](gmeow-remixOf.md) ex:originalTrack.
